name: Managerial Pyramid
excerpt: The managerial pyramid outlines the hierarchy of management roles.
notes: The managerial pyramid describes the hierarchy within management, including top managers who make long-term decisions, middle managers who implement orders and supervise first-line managers, and first-line managers who supervise employees.
context_summary:
- Outlines the hierarchy of management roles.
- Includes top managers making long-term decisions.
- Middle managers implement orders and supervise first-line managers.
- First-line managers supervise employees.
